ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels forming a continuous peripheral margin and distinct vertical striations at the basal margin.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white centroid covering the majority of the lobes. A continuous low-intensity black border outlines the trailing edge and tips. Vertical dark streaks (rake marks) originate from the lower peduncle insertion area. Sparse dark punctate spots are visible in the upper-left lobe quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 65 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 15% of the total vertical span of the fluke from the horizontal baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations present across the entire trailing edge. Serration amplitude increases towards the distal tips, presenting as a more jagged pixel boundary compared to the smoother medial sections near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a broad convexity curving towards the distal tips. Leading edges are relatively linear, curving sharply upward at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (consistent with barnacle colonization) are concentrated on the distal black tips of both lobes. Several yellowish-tan circular spots are localized on the interior white field of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of sub-parallel, vertical dark linear disruptions (rake marks) break the white pigmentation mapping, extending from the water line into the lower-middle section of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple vertical dark rake marks across the lower ventral surface of both lobes; visible barnacle attachments on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A concentrated cluster of irregular dark pixel artifacts is located at the base of the median notch near the central insertion point.
